mn83:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mithilāyaṃ viharati makhādevambavane.

mn83:2.3: ko nu kho hetu, ko paccayo bhagavato sitassa pātukammāya?
mn83:2.5: atha kho āyasmā ānando ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn83:2.6: ko nu kho bhante hetu, ko paccayo bhagavato sitassa pātukammāya?
mn83:3.1: bhūtapubbaṃ ānanda, imissāyeva mithilāyaṃ rājā ahosi makhādevo nāma dhammiko dhammarājā dhamme ṭhito mahārājā
mn83:3.2: dhammaṃ carati brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu cepi jānapadesu ca.
mn83:3.3: uposathañca upavasati cātuddasiṃ pañcadasiṃ aṭṭhamiñca pakkhassa.
mn83:4.1: atha kho ānanda, rājā makhādevo bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasatānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasahassānaṃ accayena kappakaṃ āmantesi:
mn83:4.2: ‘yadā me samma kappaka, passeyyāsi sirasmiṃ palitāni jātāni, atha me āroceyyāsī’ti.
mn83:4.3: evaṃ devāti kho ānanda, kappako rañño makhādevassa paccassosi.
mn83:4.4: addasā kho ānanda, kappako bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasatānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasahassānaṃ accayena rañño makhādevassa sirasmiṃ palitāni jātāni.
mn83:4.6: pātubhūtā kho devassa devadūtā, dissanti sirasmiṃ palitāni jātānī’ti.
mn83:4.7: tena hi samma kappaka, tāni palitāni sādhukaṃ saṇḍāsena uddharitvā mama añjalismiṃ patiṭṭhāpehī’ti.
mn83:4.8: evaṃ devāti kho ānanda, kappako rañño makhādevassa paṭissutvā tāni palitāni sādhukaṃ saṇḍāsena uddharitvā rañño makhādevassa añjalismiṃ patiṭṭhāpesi.
mn83:4.9: atha kho ānanda, rājā makhādevo kappakassa gāmavaraṃ datvā jeṭṭhaputtaṃ kumāraṃ āmantāpetvā etadavoca:
mn83:4.10: pātubhūtā kho me tāta kumāra devadūtā,
mn83:4.12: bhuttā kho pana me mānusakā kāmā,
mn83:4.14: ehi tvaṃ tāta kumāra, imaṃ rajjaṃ paṭipajja.
mn83:4.15: ahaṃ pana kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmi.
mn83:4.16: tena hi tāta kumāra, yadā tvampi passeyyāsi sirasmiṃ palitāni jātāni, atha kappakassa gāmavaraṃ datvā jeṭṭhaputtaṃ kumāraṃ sādhukaṃ rajje samanusāsitvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyāsi.
mn83:4.17: yena me idaṃ kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ anuppavatteyyāsi. mā kho me tvaṃ antimapuriso ahosi.
mn83:4.18: yasmiṃ kho tāta kumāra, purisayuge vattamāne evarūpassa kalyāṇassa vaṭṭassa samucchedo hoti so tesaṃ antimapuriso hoti.
mn83:4.19: taṃ tāhaṃ tāta kumāra, evaṃ vadāmi:
mn83:4.20: yena me idaṃ kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ anuppavatteyyāsi, mā kho me tvaṃ antimapuriso ahosī’ti.

mn83:13.1: bhūtapubbaṃ ānanda, devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi:
mn83:13.2: ‘lābhā vata bho videhānaṃ, suladdhaṃ vata bho videhānaṃ,
mn83:13.3: yesaṃ nimi rājā dhammiko dhammarājā dhamme ṭhito mahārājā
mn83:13.4: dhammaṃ carati brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu ceva jānapadesu ca,

mn83:13.8: icchāma mayaṃ mārisa, nimiṃ rājānaṃ daṭṭhunti.

mn83:13.14: ‘lābhā vata bho videhānaṃ, suladdhaṃ vata bho videhānaṃ,

mn83:20.1: nimissa kho panānananda, rañño kalārajanako nāma putto ahosi. so
mn83:21.1: siyā kho pana te ānanda, evamassa:
mn83:21.2: añño nūna tena samayena rājā makhādevo ahosi yena taṃ kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitanti.
mn83:21.3: na kho panetaṃ ānanda, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn83:21.4: ahaṃ tena samayena rājā makhādevo ahosiṃ.
mn83:21.5: ahaṃ taṃ kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihiniṃ. mayā taṃ kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ
mn83:21.7: taṃ kho panānanda, kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvadeva brahmalokūpapattiyā.
mn83:21.8: idaṃ kho panānanda, etarahi mayā kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
mn83:21.9: katamā cānanda, etarahi mayā kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati:
mn83:21.11: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
mn83:21.12: idaṃ kho ānanda, etarahi mayā kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
mn83:21.13: taṃ vo ahaṃ ānanda, evaṃ vadāmi:
mn83:21.14: yena me idaṃ kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ anuppavatteyyātha, mā kho me tumhe antimapurisā ahuvattha.
mn83:21.15: yasmiṃ kho ānanda, purisayuge vattamāne evarūpassa kalyāṇassa vaṭṭassa samucchedo hoti so tesaṃ antimapuriso hoti.
mn83:21.16: taṃ vo ahaṃ ānanda, evaṃ vadāmi:
mn83:21.17: yena me idaṃ kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ anuppavatteyyātha. mā kho me tumhe antimapurisā ahuvatthā’ti.
mn83:21.19: attamano āyasmā ānando bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
